name: SunRay Aston 200TN | 1-2 Person Traditional Indoor Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Aston 1-2 Person Indoor Traditional Sauna is designed for personal or paired relaxation. Constructed from natural Canadian cedar wood, it includes a 4.5kW Harvia electric heater that delivers temperatures up to 170°F. The side bench seating provides space and comfort, with an integrated ergonomic backrest for support. A water cask and spoon allow for steam generation, while standard features include a thermo-hygrometer, interior dome lighting, tempered glass, a ventilation system, and upgraded door hardware.
